title: Peacock Scarab Portrait
description: A stylized portrait of a teal-skinned woman with closed eyes and an elaborate updo, featuring a large white and teal peacock feather headdress. Her hand is raised to her chin with a golden scarab ring, while a giant scarab beetle and swarm of smaller beetles rest on a dark mound covered in ancient script to her right.
prompt: stylized portrait of a serene teal-skinned woman with closed eyes and elegant updo, large white peacock feather headdress with eye patterns, golden scarab ring on her hand touching her chin, giant scarab beetle and swarm of smaller beetles on a dark mound covered in ancient runes and symbols, mystical atmosphere, detailed linework with soft chalk textures on dark background
